O1.citation: "One passing run is evidence of a pass, not proof that the skill works" and "Before making a durable guidebook claim" keep the claim provisional.

O2.citation: "Re-run the skill blindly 2–3 times for every important or borderline case" and "Report the pass rate per case."

O3.citation: "using a fresh context-free agent each time" and "Have a separate judge grade each artifact" preserve separate runner and judge roles.

O4.citation: "classify the cause as a skill defect or a bad bar/case; revise only for a defensible skill defect" and "Re-evaluate all cases after every revision".

O5.citation: "Claim the skill works only when every case clears its required pass-rate bar".

S1.citation: Smell absent: artifact says "not proof that the skill works".

S2.citation: Smell absent: artifact delays the claim until "every case clears its required pass-rate bar".

S3.citation: Smell absent: artifact requires "2–3 times" reruns and says "Report the pass rate per case."

S4.citation: Smell absent: artifact says runs are done "blindly" with a "fresh context-free agent" and judged separately.

S5.citation: Smell absent: artifact says to "classify the cause" first and "revise only for a defensible skill defect."

rationale: The artifact rejects proof from a single green run, requires blind repeated trials with per-case pass rates, separates runner and judge, diagnoses failures before revision, reruns the suite after changes, and withholds durable claims until repeated evidence supports them.
